title: Cobalt Accessories
body:
*This is the modrinth version of the mod! I will Not be uploading older versions of the mod here. They are already on curseforge*

The Cobalt Accessories Mod adds *Cobalt* The brand new ore in the game, That Can be crafted into many diffrent cobalt related things.

This Mod's goal is to improve the player experinece by adding a ore that is more useful than others. And a superior to gold. By Adding New building Blocks And Tools, Weapons and so much more!

This Mod Has A little something for everyone. So Everyone Could have a taste on what cobalt in minecraft could be like.

There are also little easter eggs about the creator (Me) So Have fun. In the Biomes The Ingots And The Cobalt!
